content.headline: Course Management Made Simple
content.subhead: Everything your school needs to manage courses, track student progress, and communicate with parents. All in one beautiful platform.

resources.title: Course Builder
resources.description: Create and organize courses with our intuitive drag-and-drop interface. Add lessons, assignments, and resources in minutes.

resources.title: Student Portal
resources.description: Students access everything in one place: course materials, grades, schedules, and communication with teachers.

resources.title: Parent Dashboard
resources.description: Keep parents informed with real-time updates on attendance, grades, and upcoming assignments.

resources.title: Grade Management
resources.description: Automated grade calculations, weighted categories, and custom rubrics. Export transcripts with one click.

resources.title: Attendance Tracking
resources.description: Take attendance on any device. Generate reports and send notifications to parents automatically.

resources.title: Communication Hub
resources.description: Send announcements, schedule parent-teacher conferences, and message individual students or groups.
